newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-VANSTONE SAYS AUSTRALIA LABOUR MARKET FLAT.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-VANSTONE SAYS AUSTRALIA LABOUR MARKET FLAT.

text.p: Australian Employment minister Amanda Vanstone said on Thursday the labour market remained flat but the government was confident it could meet its forecast for unemployment to fall to eight percent by the June quarter of 1998.
Figures earlier showed employment rose 21,300 in July and unemployment also rising to 8.7 percent in July from 8.5 percent in June.
"The labour market remains flat, the trend shows us that," Vanstone told reporters.
"Now we can point to all of the indicators being in the right place for a pick up in growth in the second half of the financial year."
Asked if the government could meet its budget projection of unemployment falling to 8.0 percent by June 1998, Vanstone said: "Yes."

"The Treasurer (Peter Costello) made that abundantly clear on Tuesday, that we believe we can and that obviously means we expect a pick up in growth in the latter half of the financial year," Vanstone said.
Costello also said the jobless rate could actually fall marginally below 8.0 percent mid-1998.
